structured_output.summary: The spouse is 18, so they fall in Minnesota's Medical Assistance category for children under 19 (Minn. Stat. 256B.055 subd. 3a; 42 CFR 435.118). Its income limit is 275% FPG (256B.056 subd. 4; EPM 2.2.3.3). Neither the statute, the federal rule nor DHS's list of eligibility categories excludes married children, and MA-FCA has no asset test. The engine put the 3-person MAGI household at about 156% FPL ($42,664 against the 2026 guideline of $27,320) and found the spouse eligible under its older-child category. That matches the law, so the reference of 1 holds. The consensus answer of 0 wrongly applied the 133%/138% adult limit.
